title: Fixture-Assisted Standardization Workcell
brief: Coordinate direct handling of capped reagent bottle and empty volumetric flask through separate, observable left/right approach, grasp, lift, transfer, placement, release, and retreat sequences.

migration.legacyLearningObjective: Program OpenArm V2 Bimanual to complete the observable handling sequence.

coordination.orderSafetyPrerequisite: Each transport must complete placement contact, detachment, and retreat before the other arm begins.
coordination.claimBoundary: Each arm is scheduled sequentially from the live shared-joint state against the visible fixture proxy. The 300 mm inter-effector separation floor is configured validation, not a force, payload, dynamics, full-mesh collision, or collision-recovery claim.

tableClearance.authority: authoritative fixed-step plant and renderer consume the same object world pose and configured worktop boxes
tableClearance.stagingApparatus: intended laboratory equipment grasped directly at its declared apparatus-specific socket; the level watch glass rests directly on the real worktop with its centre of mass and configured stable footprint fraction supported
tableClearance.basis: The apparatus footprint is horizontal and supported on the worktop; the robot contacts the rendered equipment directly and maintains world-up during lift, transfer, placement, opening, and retreat.

initialStow.claim: Configured symmetric task-ready stow with open fingers, fixed base yaw, zero J5/J7, and both distal arms clear of every initial apparatus envelope.

fixtures.label: configured dual-table OpenArm workcell
fixtures.claimBoundary: The two low worktops and floor-anchored legs are teacher-visible authored configuration. Intended lab items, including the level watch glass, rest directly and stably on the real worktops with no auxiliary holder, stick, post, pin, pedestal, carrier, or hidden support. Presentation, authoritative rest validation, and collision use the same configured geometry. No calibration, force, payload, dynamics, or physical-safety claim is made.
